scoring_justification: Paper reports resistivity curve as a graph and distribution function shape; we compare agent's computed values at specific points to digital approximations from the figures and verify structural shape of the distribution.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold temperature-dependent resistivity values at selected temperatures for ρ0=0.218×10⁻⁷ Ω cm
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Fig. 5 of the paper, digitized approximation
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manual reading of the graph; the model yields approximately δρ=1.5×10⁻¹⁴ T² Ω cm.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Based on the paper's published curve; digitization tolerance included.

hidden_assets.purpose: Structural criteria for distribution function shape
hidden_assets.generation_method: Derived from paper's qualitative description: dip at y=G/(2kF)≈0.72, increasing monotonic otherwise.

outputs.description: Temperature-dependent resistivity computed from the model.

output_contract.notes: The two artifacts are scored independently. The checker will compare the agent's reported values to paper-reference values at selected points and against the required shape (e.g., a dip around y ≈ 0.72). Relative deviation within tolerance earns full credit.
